This is the bounded normal photo-preview lighting/setup closure, not the score pass, a renderer, full photo reconstruction, or a source-import manifest.

public_contracts.facts: Public Light_t byte ABI: col[3] at0, pad at3, duplicate colc[3] at4, pad at7, signed dir[3] at8, pad at11; Light union is16 bytes. Slots1..N directional, slotN+1 ambient. Direction points toward light. Direction changes require reloading light and number of lights; the original pre-render list does both. No SDK header/body is consulted.
Public LightsM ordering is Ambient followed by M diffuse Light records. Actual byte extents and colors here come only from the admitted ROM.
LIGHTING calculates vertex color from normals. SHADE and SHADING_SMOOTH retain normal smooth-shaded behavior. Enabling LIGHTING on a score pass is not a faithful preview implementation.

Public F3DEX2-compatible wire documentation: DCnnooii address has transfer size=((nn>>3)+1)*8, offset=oo*8, index0x0A=light buffer. DC08060A and DC08090A therefore DMA16 bytes to offsets48 and72. D9 geometry, DB move-word, DE nested DL, DF EndDL, E3 high-othermode and FC combiner bit encodings are decoded directly, not through SDK macros.
Public geometry, othermode, blender and combiner bit tables; only public wire interface facts are used, not producer layouts or executable implementation.
MODULATEIA multiplies texture and shade RGBA; PASS2 forwards cycle1 combined RGBA. Normal caller words are source/public-ABI-derived, not runtime-captured evidence.

lights_exact_dma_union.color_policy: Original ambient/diffuse RGB and duplicate bytes are retained in private Snapshot views. No color literals, guessed white fallback, normalized colors, relocated light records, or generated SDK structure are compiled in.
lights_exact_dma_union.extent_proof: [EBD8,EBE8) directional DMA and [EBD0,EBE0) ambient DMA overlap by8; their contiguous union is exactly24 bytes. Ambient DMA's last8 are directional RGB/duplicate storage, not another mutable direction. No unreferenced alignment tail is installed.

normal_preview_setup.not_set_here: This list does not reset base geometry, matrices, viewport/scissor/targets, cycle type, combiner, render mode or fog; those remain the actual reset/camera/model/caller responsibilities.

mutable_direction.owner: Caller-owned canonical word-swapped RDRAM during an exclusive preparation borrow after full prior RSP/RDP retirement; never Snapshot storage.
mutable_direction.calculation: Every subtraction, multiply, add, division and sqrt result is stored binary32. Preserve source left association (X*X+Y*Y)+Z*Z. First normalize XZ eye-at, then set Y=1 and normalize XYZ, then truncate f32(component*127.0f) toward zero into signed8. No algebraic collapse into a direct1/sqrt2, no binary64 normalization, no clamp.
mutable_direction.checked_domain: Round-to-nearest; finite input eye/at XZ and positive finite rounded horizontal square sum. Nonfinite/zero/overflow/underflow-to-zero horizontal directions are rejected before writes because the original NaN-to-signed-byte result is not defined by GAME C. Eye/at Y is unused. No guessed replacement direction is supplied.
mutable_direction.write_set: Exactly3 bytes at physical ((0xAEBE0+i)^3), i=0..2. RGB, duplicate RGB, padding, lists and unrelated RAM remain untouched. Return value is those signed direction bytes.

installation.layout: Exclusive caller-owned word-swapped8MiB, disjoint from Snapshot storage; destination byte=(guest-0x80000000+i) XOR3
installation.lifetime: Snapshot and its storage outlive LightingInputs and all borrowed views; do not move a borrowed Snapshot. Construction/install/update reject moved-from input. Returned descriptor access follows the same lifetime contract.
installation.preservation: Only the3 exact spans are installed; original guest addresses/pointers are unchanged. In particular the48-byte gap after light records, raw-data neighbors and opaque photo_check overlay are not installed or cleared. Reinstall restores original ROM direction, so update_direction follows installation for the active camera. No per-update allocation or payload copy other than the3 required direction bytes.

parent_integration_contract.execution_order: Bind segment0; ordinary GAME reset/base geometry and target/viewport/scissor policy; global pre-render call to pre_render_guest() AFTER reset's lighting clear; actual camera initialization and perspective/normalization/look-at PROJECTION commands; per-camera normal-preview setup via normal_setup_guest() and actual caller state; genuine photo-model/fog/material traversal. Preserve exclusive prepare -> actual RSP -> actual RDP -> completed CPU read -> full retirement ownership.
normal_caller_sequence: Custom opaque render mode AA_EN|Z_CMP|Z_UPD|IM_RD|CVG_DST_CLAMP|ZMODE_OPA|ALPHA_CVG_SEL with c1/c2 blender(IN,0,MEM,0), plus NOOP2
parent_integration_contract.caller_word_evidence_limit: Dynamic caller words above are independently encoded from pinned GAME C and public GBI bit tables; they are not an executed or captured display list. Actual normal setup/pre-render list words are available directly through checked borrowed views/command getters.
parent_integration_contract.score_boundary: Score setup deliberately clears LIGHTING. Keep existing score mode lighting OFF and its FRUSTRATIO_1 and scoring policy unchanged; do not reuse the preview list after score setup. Normal photo_check setup uses FRUSTRATIO_6, not a hand-adjusted score path.
parent_integration_contract.component_nonclaims: Does not prepare producer tasks, import SDK producers, bind renderer memory, acquire fences, reconstruct world/sky/items/effects/other species/poses, run time-of-day mutation, calculate score or claim game boot. Parent owns root CMake/docs/producer integration.

parent_verification_plan_not_exercised_b: Compile/link photo_lighting.cpp into parent-owned targets with strict floating-point flags; run existing CPU/Release/sanitizer gates only after integration.

Admit the private exact ROM; assert both list guest/ROM mappings,8/14 commands, final EndDL, all reference extents and zero nested references. Independently compare all200 installed bytes against Snapshot with word swap.

Initialize caller RAM with nonuniform guards and assert every byte outside the3 exact installation spans is unchanged, including48-byte light/list gap and both adjacent overlay neighbors. Rejected size/moved/alias installs must write nothing.

Compare update direction with independently evaluated exact GAME binary32 XZ-normalize -> Y1 -> XYZ-normalize -> truncate*127 for +/-X,+/-Z, diagonals and non-axis directions. Eye/at Y-only changes must not affect it. Exercise negative truncation, invalid horizontal inputs and rounding modes; rejection writes nothing.

Across direction updates, compare all bytes against pre-update RAM: only3 direction bytes may differ. Verify ambient/diffuse RGB, duplicate bytes, pads, both lists, Snapshot and every unrelated RAM byte unchanged. Reinstall then restore camera must reproduce exact original/current expected bytes.

Run a real preview task through existing actual canonical RSP/RDP ownership using original ROM Pidgey normals/textures/TLUT and full color+Z targets, original borrowed normal setup, current camera direction and genuine fog/material sequence. Inspect a private real RGB image for lit normal shading and palette detail; nonzero pixels/triangle count alone is not proof.

Repeat identical preview inputs and restore camera/time/world inputs for exact output repeatability. To isolate light sensitivity from camera/matrix motion, hold pose and camera matrices fixed and vary only source-valid light-direction inputs in a diagnostic prepare: RGB should respond while geometry coverage/Z remains consistent. Restore original direction and recover original RGB/Z.

Check score mode never re-enables lighting and retains existing score output; preview/score alternation must not leak lighting/clip/blender state across tasks. No arena growth or per-frame heap allocation, resource mutation, host-pointer truncation, skipped ownership retirement or hidden-RAM reset is acceptable.
